iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: ACTIVE US-Israel-Iran war since Feb 28 2026 (Operation Epic Fury). US-Israel targeting nuclear infrastructure. Iran rejected ceasefire Apr 6. Apr 7 ceasefire fragile. UN certified Iran NOT yet at weapons-grade enrichment. Putin warned US-Israel to stop.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Active war. ~900 US-Israel strikes first 12hrs Feb 28. Iran struck back at US bases in Bahrain, Jordan, Kuwait, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, UAE. Strait of Hormuz threatened. Hezbollah engaged.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel–Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Ceasefire collapsed. Israel expanding southern Lebanon invasion Mar 29. 500+ killed since Nov 2024. Protests at US embassy Tel Aviv Apr 6 demanding end to wars.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: FM Fidan declined to rule out nuclear weapons acquisition (Feb 9 2026). NATO expanding footprint. FDD warns Turkey challenging Western interests.

india.name: India–Pakistan
india.notes: CFR report: terror activity in Kashmir as trigger for possible armed conflict 2026. Mini-war May 2025. Both countries boosting weapons. US intel warns nuclear conflict possible.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: New START expired Feb 4 2026. Putin fiery warning to Trump/Bibi re Iran nuclear facilities. Nuclear doctrine allows use against large-scale conventional attacks. Russia standing with Iran.

china.name: China
china.notes: US intel does NOT expect Taiwan invasion 2027. PLA Navy preparing new Type 09V SSGN. Dec 2025 exercises simulated blockade. Beijing prefers peaceful unification.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: NK declared nuclear status 'irreversible' Apr 7 2026. Multiple ballistic missiles fired Apr 7 (second event in 2 days). Submarine missile test launches imminent (maintenance complete).

russia_ukraine.name: Russia–Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4. Russia warns escalation over nuclear use. GCRI: risk if Russia fails. Hybrid warfare intensifying. No negotiated settlement in sight.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan–Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: Pakistan declared 'open war' on Afghanistan Feb 27. First direct Pakistani attacks on Taliban government. Hundreds killed. Diplomatic relations severed.
